extraction_notes: The transfer, output, and reverse-transfer-capacitance curves required for an F2 attempt are available and were digitized as typical 25 degC traces where applicable.
The datasheet provides no typical VGS(th); only MIN = 0.5 V and MAX = 1.5 V are published at VDS = VGS and ID = 1.0 mA.

The two published RDS(on) rows are 5.6 ohm typical at VGS = 2.75 V and ID < 0.2 A, TA = -40 to +85 degC, and 3.5 ohm typical at VGS = 5.0 V and ID = 0.2 A. The first row also publishes a 10 ohm maximum.
IDSS table limits are 0.1 uA maximum at VDS = 25 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 25 degC; 0.5 uA maximum at VDS = 50 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 25 degC; and 5.0 uA maximum at VDS = 50 V, VGS = 0 V, TJ = 150 degC.
Figure 12 provides Crss versus VDS only to 25 V, while the device drain-source rating is 50 V; extrapolation above 25 V is not directly supported by the published capacitance curve.
The body-diode forward-voltage value is a digitized 25 degC curve read at approximately 0.2 A; no reverse-recovery time or charge is published.
The maximum-ratings table publishes RthetaJA = 556 K/W at TA = 25 degC; no RthetaJC value is published.

The gate-charge curve is available on p. 3 Fig. 5 but is omitted from this minimum extraction because the MOSFET archetype treats Qg as an independent verification target rather than a fitting target.
